verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a cloud platform, but the evidence pack documents no AWS capability for exporting all account data in open formats or for an exit or offboarding path. The CLI, S3 storage, JSON-format IAM policies and CloudFormation stack deletion are only building blocks or adjacent features. None of them is a documented export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
